import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # Placeholders: {title} and {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for secure web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- * All user input is escaped using `html.escape` to neutralize HTML injection attempts (CWE‑78, CWE‑79). * The function does not allow arbitrary tags; only the static `BLOG_FORMAT` template is used, preventing CWE‑707 (improper neutralization of structured data). """ # Escape user input to avoid XSS and ensure well‑formed HTML. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML snippet. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_text) return formatted_post
